scenes.prompt_summary: Style anchor: crimson apple knight with glowing longsword facing the green apple elder with a carved staff across the overgrown stone arena, castle and waterfall behind.
Golden apple child with a radiant apple-orb staff facing the moon-apple sorceress with a floating moon orb, quiet moment before the duel.
Wide establishing shot: two backlit warrior silhouettes far apart in the arena, faces and costume detail hidden — identity-agnostic opener.
Crimson knight lunges with a bright horizontal longsword arc while the green elder braces behind his staff and a green barrier flares.
Green elder slams his staff and hurls a spiralling bolt of emerald nature magic while the crimson knight raises his sword crosswise to meet it.
Golden child sweeps a wide arc of sunlight from the radiant staff; the moon sorceress raises a shield of blue moonlight.
Crimson knight catches the green elder's staff on the flat of his sword in a flash of sparks and turns his wrist to push past the guard.
Moon sorceress absorbs a golden strike on her crescent barrier and returns a crescent blade of moonlight; the golden child is knocked wide.
Green elder twists aside leaving a green afterimage and swirling leaves while the crimson knight's glowing sword cuts empty air.
Golden child leaps aside trailing sparkles and an afterimage while a crescent of blue moonlight sweeps through the space he left.
Crimson longsword and green elder's staff meet at the arena centre in a burst of white-gold light with a low ring shockwave of dust.
Reaction shot: an expanding ring of light and dust races across the empty stone arena, petals hurled outward, no identifiable fighters.
Green elder plants his staff and gathers a rising spiral of glowing leaves and emerald light around himself while the crimson knight watches.
Golden child raises his staff as golden light spirals up around him; the moon sorceress gathers blue moonlight in both hands.
Green elder down on one knee behind his braced staff, clearly strained but unharmed, while the crimson knight's blade bears down — the at-risk moment.
Golden child cornered behind his staff, straining but unharmed, as the moon sorceress' moonlight presses in — the at-risk moment for the opposite pair.
Crimson knight bursts through the green elder's guard in a burst of light and petals, the duel's momentum visibly shifting.
Moon sorceress steps through a burst of blue moonlight and blossoms as the golden child's guard is broken — the duel's momentum visibly shifting.
Crimson knight leaps in for an overhead finishing strike wreathed in golden light while the green elder raises a last desperate defence.
Moon sorceress unleashes a huge silver crescent at the golden child, who raises a last blazing golden barrier — the finishing blow for the opposite pair.
Crimson knight alone at the arena centre, sword raised in triumph, golden light and blossoms swirling — winner celebration.
Identity-agnostic celebration: a single backlit champion silhouette raising a weapon toward the light as petals rain down.
Identity-free clash: two backlit warrior silhouettes lunge at each other and their weapons meet in a burst of light — used for matchups without a dedicated cast plate.
Identity-free reaction shot: a vertical column of white-gold energy erupts from the arena, shattering stone and hurling petals — no characters in frame.
Identity-free celebration: a lone rim-lit champion plants a weapon and raises a fist toward the sun, face and colours hidden.
